item.title: The Supreme Court rejects Trump's mail voting restrictions for this year's midterms
item.description: The Supreme Court has rejected the Trump administration's request to allow mail-in voting restrictions under a U.S. Postal Service plan for the midterm general election.
item.content:encoded:
The Supreme Court has rejected the Trump administration's request to allow mail-in voting restrictions under a U.S. Postal Service plan for the midterm general election.

(Image credit: Patrick T. Fallon)

item.title: Trump's EPA repeals pollution limits on fossil fuel power plants
item.description: The Trump administration is eliminating limits on climate-warming pollution from the nation's fossil fuel power plants. Environmental groups say this will impact the climate and public health.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: This city led the way on reparations for Black people. Trump is trying to stop it
item.description: Evanston, Ill., became the first U.S. city to compensate Black people for historical discrimination. The Justice Department is trying to kill its program before other cities follow suit.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Forecast says families will spend more to heat their homes this winter
item.description: It's probably going to cost more to heat your home this winter. Forecasters say heating bills are likely to climb faster than overall inflation, despite what's expected to be a relatively mild winter.

item.title: Kennedy Center board says venue could close soon due to financial woes
item.description: NPR's A Martinez speaks with Washington Post arts and government reporter Jonathan Edwards about internal documents showing the Kennedy Center could close as soon as Tuesday.

item.title: Amazon suspends use of 21 Air, cargo carrier whose plane careened off Miami runway
item.description: Amazon said it's decided to pause operations with 21 Air as the investigation into the crash continues. North Carolina-based 21 had flown packages for Amazon since 2024.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Wisconsin congressman survives emergency plane landing, swims to safety
item.description: Wisconsin Congressman Tom Tiffany escaped a sinking plane and swam to shallow water after an emergency landing in a lake. Tiffany and the pilot called 911 from on top of the plane.

item.title: 25 years post 9/11, a grieving sister finds peace at United 93 crash site
item.description: On September 11, 2001 Lori Guadagno lost her brother on flight United 93. 25 years later, the crash site is a place where she feels a sense of connection that she can't find anywhere else.
